changelog: [Priority Rules] — clarified how to handle conflicts under the 6-character spacing rule: advise ranking safer candidate higher and note that a later format-enforcement step may drop lower-ranked candidates. This prevents the instruction to 'mark both' which led to too-close tags.

[Decision Procedure] — added a final FORMAT ENFORCEMENT pass that enforces the spacing and other output constraints from [Output Rules]: if two candidates are closer than 6 characters (or would place a tag within 6 characters of an end) the lower-confidence one is removed; candidates that would split numeric+unit groups or produce segments starting with trailing punctuation are removed; if removals cause too few tags, select additional remaining candidates that respect spacing. This keeps step 1 generous but ensures final output meets format constraints.
